page.overview:
Who is Nola Stein?

Captain Nola Stein was a soldier of House Atreides.

Nola Stein was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. She told them that she needed their help, as she was being blackmailed due to a leak. She informed them that someone had filmed an intimate encounter between her and Senior Lieutenant David Inius and told them to locate him at the courtyard of the Atreides residency. The Prisoner later returned with the shigawire and Stein was grateful to them for helping her and Inius and for not reporting them.
